integrity: All coefficients use exact labelled counting, with a self-contained combinatorial proof and a Python standard-library exhaustive small-case checker. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The complete polynomial holds for two-factor rook graphs; the one-dimensional case admits no 2-step dominating subset. Previously known minimum cardinalities are not new. Dod (2016) could not be inspected beyond abstract, so definitive bibliographic priority and independent mathematical validation remain outstanding.
title: Exact two-step-domination polynomial of rectangular rook graphs
